tool_input.command: for f in /Users/chuckcatron/Code/test-ideas/lilbuddy/docs/hook-event-samples/*PreToolUse*.json; do tool=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('$f')); print(d.get('tool_name',''))"); if [ "$tool" = "Read" ]; then echo "=== $(basename $f) ==="; cat "$f"; echo; break; fi; done
tool_input.description: Find a Read PreToolUse event to check for file_path
